verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the integrations-page claim that mParticle connects customer data to "data warehousing solutions," which suggests outbound warehouse delivery but gives no detail. Warehouse Sync runs the other way, ingesting from the customer's warehouse into mParticle, so it is not credited for this export story. Missing for 10: documented outbound export of raw events and profiles to named destinations (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3), user-controlled scheduling or cadence, schema details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control
